package.name: amazing_hand_kinematics
package.description: Closed-loop rod/gimbal linkage solver for the amazing_hand end effector (URDF FK + box-constrained nonlinear least squares) - pure Eigen/urdf, no rclcpp dependency. Structural C++ port of openarm_description/scripts/hand_kinematics_node.py's math. Consumed by control/robot_control's topic-based hand_kinematic node and control/robot_hardware_interface's AmazingHandHW ros2_control plugin.
